name: Retirement Package
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Vantage Point's first Haas-Bioroid and Weyland cards — Méliès City Luxury Line, Sleipnir, Retirement Plan, Flywheel, Vulture Fund — on Discretion Advised's frame, under Engineering the Future. Eternal-legal only. Vantage Point Stage 3a: Reverb for Whitespace, and two Synchrocyclotron for two NICO Campaign, lowering Retirement Plan's additional click. Vantage Point Stage 3b: Perfect Recall for Manegarm Skunkworks. Vantage Point Stage 4a: Vertigo for Tithe. Vantage Point Stage 4b: two Ansel 2.0 for two Ansel 1.0. Stage 5a: Caveat Emptor for two Hedge Fund. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 1: two Corporate Hospitality for two Government Subsidy. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 5a: two Working Prototype for the NICO Campaign and the Government Subsidy. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 5b: two Sorocaban Blade for the Palisade and the Pharos. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 5c: two Brasília Government Grid for two Seamless Launch, and two Warm Reception for two Predictive Planogram. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 5d: two Lightning Laboratory for two Offworld Office, point for point. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 6a: two Active Policing for the Predictive Planogram and the Hedge Fund. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 8a: two Lycian Multi-Munition for a Vertigo and a Reverb, ice for ice. The Automata Initiative Stage 1: two Salvo Testing for two Méliès City Luxury Line, point for point, and two Jaguarundi for two Flywheel, sentry for sentry. The Automata Initiative Stage 2: two M.I.C. for two Sleipnir. The Automata Initiative Stage 4: two Stegodon MK IV for the Offworld Office and the Vulture Fund, the points kept at 21, with ice on every server to derez as a run begins. Parhelion Stage 3c: two Pulse for its two Vertigo and two Bloop for its two M.I.C., harmonic ice that pays for Bloop's rez with Pulse's derez; both it gave up are in Undertow. Midnight Sun Stage 1: two Élivágar Bifurcation for its two Stegodon MK IV, a point for a point, which derezzes a card as it is scored; and two Refuge Campaign for its two Synchrocyclotron, an asset for an asset. Undertow and Deterrence keep what it gave up. Midnight Sun Stage 4: two Midnight-3 Arcology for its two Lightning Laboratory, point for point. Midnight Sun Stage 5: two Wave for its two Jaguarundi, a fourth harmonic ice beside Pulse, Reverb and Bloop, and two Hákarl 1.0 for its two Brân 1.0, a bioroid barrier for a bioroid barrier; Undertow keeps both. Midnight Sun Stage 7b: two Big Deal for its two Retirement Plan, an operation for an operation, four counters that score Send a Message, Salvo Testing or Midnight-3 Arcology from nothing or near it; Deterrence keeps Retirement Plan. Midnight Sun Stage 8a: two Echo for its two Sorocaban Blade, a cheap piece of ice for a dear one, which ends the run once for each harmonic ice rezzed beside it; Deterrence and Undertow keep Sorocaban Blade. Midnight Sun Stage 8b: two Trieste Model Bioroids for its two Working Prototype, an asset for an asset, which keeps Runner cards from breaking Ansel 1.0, Ansel 2.0 or Hákarl 1.0 for as long as it is rezzed; Deterrence keeps Working Prototype. Uprising Stage 1: two Bass CH1R180G4 for its two Warm Reception, two Cerebral Overwriter for its two Perfect Recall and two Drafter for its two Ansel 2.0, Haas-Bioroid for Haas-Bioroid; Deterrence keeps all three, and Undertow two of them. Uprising Stage 4: two Tranquility Home Grid for its two Brasília Government Grid, an upgrade for an upgrade, and two Vaporframe Fabricator for its two Active Policing, which install for nothing; Deterrence keeps both, and Undertow Active Policing. Uprising Stage 5: Týr for its Sleipnir, a bioroid sentry the Runner may break by losing a click, which gives the Corp one; Deterrence keeps Sleipnir. Uprising Stage 7a gave its two Reverb (still in Undertow) for two NEXT Activation Command, a lockdown that strengthens every piece of ice and bars a bioroid's own break, and its two Lycian Multi-Munition (still in Deterrence and Undertow) for two NAPD Cordon, a lockdown that taxes a steal. Uprising Stage 8: three Megaprix Qualifier and two Project Vacheron for its three Send a Message, the same 21 points in two more cards — a 1-point agenda worth 2 when another copy was scored or stolen before it, and a 3-point agenda the Runner steals worth nothing for four of their turns; twenty decks keep Send a Message. Downfall Stage 4: two Vulnerability Audit for two Salvo Testing, point for point, an agenda never scored the turn it is installed. Reprints Stage 2: two Rototurret for its two Echo and two Eli 1.0 for its two Wave; both are still in Endless Loop. Tranche 8 Stage 6b: two Archived Memories for its two Caveat Emptor, an operation for an operation; Endless Loop keeps Caveat Emptor. Tranche 8 Stage 9a: two Marilyn Campaign for its two Refuge Campaign, a campaign for a campaign, which pays 2[credit] a turn from the 8[credit] it loads and may shuffle itself into R&D when it is trashed; Assembly Line and Endless Loop keep Refuge Campaign. Tranche 8 Stage 9h: two Magnet for its two Rototurret, ice for ice, which takes a trojan off the ice it was on and blanks it; Assembly Line keeps Rototurret. Tranche 8 Stage 11c: two Viktor 1.0 for its two Pulse, a code gate for a code gate; Endless Loop keeps Pulse.
